A1.question: She _____ a teacher. She works at a primary school.
A1.explanation: 'She' olmoshi uchun Present Simple zamonida 'to be' fe'lining 'is' shakli ishlatiladi.

A1.question: Where _____ you live?
A1.explanation: 'You' olmoshi bilan Present Simple so'roq gaplarida yordamchi fe'l 'do' ishlatiladi.

A1.question: Look! There are two _____ in the park.
A1.explanation: 'Child' so'zining ko'plik shakli noto'g'ri (irregular) ot bo'lib, 'children' bo'ladi.

A1.question: I don't have _____ milk in the fridge.
A1.explanation: Inkor gaplarda sanalmaydigan otlar oldidan 'any' ishlatiladi.

A1.question: What time _____ you go to bed yesterday?
A1.explanation: O'tgan zamonda (yesterday) savol berish uchun 'did' yordamchi fe'lidan foydalaniladi.

A1.question: This is my brother. _____ name is David.
A1.explanation: O'g'il bola / erkak kishi uchun egalik olmoshi 'His' (uning) bo'ladi.

A1.question: They _____ to London last summer.
A1.explanation: 'Go' fe'lining Past Simple (o'tgan zamon) shakli 'went' bo'ladi.

A1.question: Can you _____ English?
A1.explanation: Modal fe'llardan (can, could, must va h.k.) keyin fe'lning oddiy (bare infinitive) shakli keladi.

A1.question: My birthday is _____ May.
A1.explanation: Oylar nomi oldidan 'in' predlogi ishlatiladi (in May).

A1.question: He _____ like coffee; he prefers tea.
A1.explanation: 'He/She/It' olmoshlari bilan Present Simple inkorida 'doesn't' ishlatiladi.

A2.question: While I _____ my homework, the phone rang.
A2.explanation: O'tgan zamonda davom etayotgan harakat uchun Past Continuous ('was doing') ishlatiladi.

A2.question: Tashkent is much _____ than Samarkand.
A2.explanation: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlarning qiyosiy darajasida oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi va '-er' qo'shiladi ('bigger').

A2.question: Have you ever _____ to Japan?
A2.explanation: Hayotiy tajribani so'rashda (borib kelganmisiz) Present Perfect zamonida 'been to' ishlatiladi.

A2.question: If it rains tomorrow, we _____ at home.
A2.explanation: First Conditional (birinchi shart mayli): If + Present Simple, will + verb.

A2.question: You _____ wear a uniform at our school; it's a strict rule.
A2.explanation: Qat'iy qoida va majburiyatni ifodalash uchun 'must' modal fe'li ishlatiladi.

A2.question: I am interested _____ learning new languages.
A2.explanation: 'Interested' sifati doimo 'in' predlogi bilan birga ishlatiladi (interested in).

A2.question: The room _____ cleaned every morning by the housekeeper.
A2.explanation: Present Simple majhul nisbat (Passive voice): am/is/are + V3 (is cleaned).

A2.question: She didn't eat _____ for breakfast because she wasn't hungry.
A2.explanation: Ingliz tilida inkor gapda faqat bitta inkor so'z bo'ladi, shuning uchun 'anything' to'g'ri.

A2.question: He told me that he _____ tired.
A2.explanation: O'zlashtirma gapda (Reported Speech) o'tgan zamon qoidasiga ko'ra 'is' -> 'was' ga o'zgaradi.

A2.question: I look forward to _____ you next week.
A2.explanation: 'Look forward to' iborasidan keyin fe'lning '-ing' (gerund) shakli keladi.

B1.question: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the film _____.
B1.explanation: O'tgan zamondagi boshqa bir harakatdan oldin sodir bo'lgan ish-harakat uchun Past Perfect ('had started') ishlatiladi.

B1.question: If I _____ you, I would take that job offer.
B1.explanation: Second Conditional shart maylida norasmiy va rasmiy holatda maslahat berishda 'were' ishlatiladi ('If I were you').

B1.question: He managed _____ the exam despite not studying enough.
B1.explanation: 'Manage' fe'li o'zidan keyin 'to + infinitive' talab qiladi ('managed to pass').

B1.question: Although it was raining heavily, _____ we enjoyed our trip.
options: they enjoyed our trip (no extra conjunction)
B1.explanation: 'Although' bo'lgan gaplarda ergash gap boshida 'but' yoki 'however' bog'lovchisi qo'shilmaydi.

B1.question: I haven't seen Sarah _____ three months.
B1.explanation: Vaqt davomiyligi (muddat) ko'rsatilganda 'for' predlogi ishlatiladi ('for three months').

B1.question: The bridge _____ built in 1995.
B1.explanation: O'tgan aniq yilda (in 1995) bajarilgan majhul nisbatdagi ish-harakat uchun Past Simple Passive ('was built') ishlatiladi.

B1.question: Neither John _____ Peter knew the answer to the question.
B1.explanation: 'Neither' juft bog'lovchisi doimo 'nor' bilan ishlatiladi ('neither ... nor').

B1.question: She asked me where _____ .
B1.explanation: Reported questions (o'zlashtirma so'roq gaplar) to'g'ri so'z tartibida bo'ladi: Ega + Kesim ('where I lived').

B1.question: You shouldn't have _____ that to your boss.
B1.explanation: O'tgan zamondagi pushaymonlik: modal + have + V3 ('shouldn't have said').

B1.question: He is used to _____ up early every morning.
B1.explanation: 'Be used to' (ko'nikib qolgan bo'lmoq) iborasidan keyin Gerund (V-ing) keladi ('used to waking').

B2.question: Had I known about the meeting, I _____ attended.
B2.explanation: Third Conditional inversiya holati: 'Had I known..., I would have attended'.

B2.question: She regrets _____ so rude to her colleague during yesterday's discussion.
B2.explanation: O'tgan ishdan afsuslanish ma'nosida 'regret' fe'li gerund (V-ing) talab qiladi ('regret being').

B2.question: Not only _____ the match, but they also broke a tournament record.
B2.explanation: 'Not only' jumlasi gap boshida kelsa, inversiya yuzaga keladi: yordamchi fe'l egadan oldinga chiqadi ('did they win').

B2.question: The company's profits have dropped significantly _____ the rising fuel prices.
B2.explanation: Otdan yoki otlashgan birikmadan oldin sabab bildirish uchun 'due to' (tufayli) ishlatiladi.

B2.question: It is essential that every student _____ the safety rules.
B2.explanation: Present Subjunctive: 'It is essential that + subject + bare infinitive (follow)'.

B2.question: We had our car _____ at the local garage yesterday.
B2.explanation: Causative form (boshqa birovga qildirmoq): have + object + V3 ('had our car repaired').

B2.question: She speaks fluent Spanish, _____ her sister doesn't know a word.
By next December, we _____ on this project for three solid years.
B2.explanation: Kelajakdagi aniq vaqtgacha davom etib kelayotgan muddat: Future Perfect Continuous ('will have been working').

B2.question: He was accused _____ stealing trade secrets from his former employer.
B2.explanation: 'Accuse' fe'li 'of' predlogi bilan bog'lanadi ('accused of doing something').

B2.question: The negotiations are expected to be tough; _____, both sides are keen to reach an agreement.
B2.explanation: 'Nonetheless' (shunga qaramay) qarama-qarshi fikrlarni bog'lash uchun ishlatiladi.

C1.question: Seldom _____ such an inspiring and eloquent keynote speech.
C1.explanation: Kamdan-kam (Seldom) inkoriy ma'noli ravish gap boshida kelganda inversiya qo'llaniladi ('have I heard').

C1.question: The committee decided to postpone the vote, _____ the lack of quorum.
C1.explanation: 'Owing to' rasmiy tilda sabab-oqibatni (tufayli, sababli) bildirish uchun ot birikmasi oldidan keladi.

C1.question: He is widely regarded as one of the foremost _____ on international monetary policy.
C1.explanation: 'Authority on [subject]' ma'lum sohada yetuk mutaxassis yoki nufuzli olim ma'nosidagi akademik birikmadir.

C1.question: No sooner had the curtain fallen _____ the audience erupted into deafening applause.
C1.explanation: 'No sooner had ... than' birikmasi o'zgarmas grammatik qolip bo'lib, harakat ketma-ketligini bildiradi.

C1.question: Her groundbreaking research shed fresh _____ on the origins of the phenomenon.
C1.explanation: 'Shed light on' (oydinlik kiritmoq) turg'un frazeologik ibora hisoblanadi.

C1.question: The CEO's resignation came _____ a bolt from the blue.
C1.explanation: 'Come as a bolt from the blue' (kutilmaganda chaqmoqdek yopirilmoq / kutilmagan voqea bo'lmoq) idiomatik ifodadir.

C1.question: Under no circumstances _____ confidential documents to unauthorized personnel.
C1.explanation: 'Under no circumstances' (hech qanday holatda) inkor iborasi inversiyani talab qiladi ('should you disclose').

C1.question: The new legislation is likely to meet with fierce _____ from environmental activists.
C1.explanation: Qonun loyihasiga qarshilik bildirish kontekstida 'meet with fierce opposition' turg'un kollokatsiyadir.

C1.question: It's high time the government _____ tangible measures to curb inflation.
C1.explanation: 'It's high time + subject + Past Simple' konstruktsiyasi allaqachon bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan ishni bildiradi ('took').

C1.question: So captivating _____ that no one wanted to leave the auditorium.
C1.explanation: 'So + adjective' gap boshida kelganda inversiya qo'llanadi: 'So captivating was the performance...'.

C2.question: His controversial statements served only to _____ fuel to the flames of existing tensions.
C2.explanation: 'Add fuel to the flames / fire' (olovga moy sepmoq, vaziyatni yanada keskinlashtirmoq) standart ingliz idiomasidir.

C2.question: Were it not for his unwavering perseverance, the venture would surely have _____.
C2.explanation: 'Founder' (kema yoki loyiha haqida) cho'kmoq, barbod bo'lmoq ma'nosida ishlatiladi. 'Flounder' esa nochor qolmoq ma'nosida.

C2.question: The defense attorney argued that the evidence was purely circumstantial and lacked any _____ value.
C2.explanation: 'Probative value' yuridik tilda 'isbotlash qimmati / kuchi' degan ma'noni anglatadi.

C2.question: She has an extraordinary knack _____ discerning underlying motives in complex diplomatic talks.
C2.explanation: 'Knack for [doing something]' (biror narsaga xos qobiliyat / iste'dod) predlogli birikmasidir.

C2.question: The minister's remarks sparked a contentious debate that shows no sign of _____.
C2.explanation: 'Abate' susaymoq, pasaymoq degani. 'Show no sign of abating' turg'un iboradir.

C2.question: Much _____ he tried to mask his disdain, it was plainly evident in his demeanor.
C2.explanation: 'Much as + subject + verb' (qanchalik urinmasin, garchi... qilsa ham) mazmunida ishlatiladigan rasmiy tuzilma.

C2.question: The candidate's reputation was thoroughly _____ by the investigative journalist's revelations.
C2.explanation: 'Besmirch' (obro'ni bulg'amoq, qoralamoq) so'zi bu kontekstda eng mos akademik va yuqori darajadagi leksik birlikdir.

C2.question: In the face of adversity, she exhibited a remarkable degree of _____ and composure.
C2.explanation: 'Equanimity' qiyin vaziyatda xotirjamlik va bosiqlikni saqlash fazilati (composure bilan sinonim) hisoblanadi.

C2.question: Little _____ that the innocuous agreement would ultimately precipitate a diplomatic crisis.
C2.explanation: 'Little' inkor ma'nosida gap boshida kelsa, inversiya talab etiladi: 'did they suspect'.

C2.question: The treaty was deemed null and _____ following revelations of systemic breaches.
C2.explanation: 'Null and void' (yuridik kuchini yo'qotgan, o'z kuchini yo'qotgan) huquqiy va C2 darajadagi binomial iboradir.
